findings.title: No CloudTrail trail is logging
findings.detail: 1 trail(s) exist but none is logging
findings.remediation: Create a multi-region trail with log file validation, and make sure logging is started.

findings.title: SSH/RDP open to the internet
findings.detail: us-east-1: open to the internet on 22 (SSH)
findings.remediation: Restrict the rule to known IP ranges, or remove it and use SSM Session Manager or a bastion host instead.

findings.title: Database port open to the internet
findings.detail: us-east-1: open to the internet on 3306 (MySQL)
findings.remediation: Remove the internet-facing rule; allow the database port only from the application's security group.

findings.title: Console user without MFA
findings.detail: console password set, no MFA device
findings.remediation: Enable an MFA device for the user, or remove their console password if they only need programmatic access.

findings.title: Policy grants full admin (*:*)
findings.remediation: Replace the wildcard statement with the specific actions and resources the principal needs.

findings.title: Root account used recently
findings.detail: root used via console sign-in 2d ago
findings.remediation: Stop using the root account for daily work: create an admin IAM user or role, delete root access keys, and enable root MFA.

findings.title: Bucket allows public access
findings.remediation: Enable Block Public Access on the bucket, remove AllUsers/AuthenticatedUsers ACL grants, and scope the bucket policy to specific principals.

findings.title: Trail is not multi-region
findings.remediation: Turn on IsMultiRegionTrail so activity in every region is recorded.

findings.title: EBS volume not encrypted
findings.remediation: Snapshot the volume, copy the snapshot with encryption on, and restore from it. Turn on EBS encryption by default for new volumes.

findings.title: Access key older than 90 days
findings.remediation: Create a new access key, move workloads to it, then deactivate and delete the old one.

findings.title: Default encryption not enabled
findings.remediation: Enable default server-side encryption (SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS) on the bucket.

findings.title: Log file validation disabled
findings.remediation: Enable log file validation so tampering with delivered logs can be detected.

findings.title: Versioning disabled
findings.remediation: Enable versioning so overwritten or deleted objects can be recovered.

findings.title: Access logging disabled
findings.remediation: Enable server access logging to a separate, dedicated log bucket.
